name: High Performance and Specialty Fibres
description: Definition, classification and structural requirements of high performance and specialty fibres; concept of gel spinning and spinning of UHMPE fibres; polymerization, spinning and properties of aramids, aromatic polyesters; rigid rod and ladder polymers such as PBZT, PBO, PBI and PIPD; manufacture of carbon fibres from poly(acrylonitrile), viscose and pitch precursors; thermally and chemically resistant polymers and fibres; methods of synthesis and properties of glass and ceramic fibres; specialty fibres: profile fibres, bi-component fibres and hybrid fibres; elastomeric fibres; superabsorbent polymers and fibres; stimuli responsive fibres.
